title: Financial Assistance & Welfare
description: Zakat and welfare support for patients who cannot afford essential medical care.
excerpt: Hijaz Hospital provides financial assistance to eligible patients through its Shariah-Compliant Zakat Management System and charitable welfare programs.

hero.title: Financial Assistance & Welfare
hero.excerpt: Hijaz Hospital is committed to ensuring that financial hardship does not prevent deserving patients from receiving essential medical care. Through its Shariah-Compliant Zakat Management System and charitable welfare programs, the hospital provides financial assistance to eligible patients with fairness, dignity, and compassion.

sections.heading: Shariah-Compliant Zakat Management System
body: Hijaz Hospital has established a Shariah-Compliant Zakat Management System (ZMS) under the supervision of qualified Islamic scholars and respected Muftis. The system ensures that Zakat donations are received, managed, and utilized strictly in accordance with the teachings of the Qur'an and Sunnah.

All Zakat contributions are maintained in a dedicated account separate from other hospital funds. Patient eligibility is assessed by the Welfare Shariah Department, where each case is reviewed with complete confidentiality and respect for the patient's dignity.

sections.heading: Financial Assistance for Deserving Patients
body: Hijaz Hospital provides financial assistance to patients who are unable to afford medical treatment. Depending on eligibility, support may be provided through Zakat and Sadqat-e-Wajiba funds, general donations, or other charitable welfare resources.
Each application is assessed individually based on the patient's financial circumstances, medical needs, and the availability of assistance.

sections.heading: Eligibility & Application Process
items: Contact the Welfare Shariah Department for guidance
Submit an application for financial assistance
Assessment of financial circumstances and medical requirements
Review by the Welfare Department and, where applicable, the Welfare Shariah Department
Approval in accordance with applicable welfare or Zakat criteria

title: Patient Admission Process
description: A structured admission process for smooth coordination and timely treatment.
excerpt: Hijaz Hospital follows a structured admission process to ensure smooth coordination, timely treatment, and quality patient care.

hero.title: Patient Admission Process
hero.tagline: Your Journey from Consultation to Care
hero.excerpt: Hijaz Hospital follows a structured admission process to ensure smooth coordination, timely treatment, and quality patient care from your first consultation through discharge.

sections.heading: OPD Consultation & Assessment
body: Patients visit the OPD Registration Counter for registration and consultation. A department-wise token is issued, and the patient meets the relevant consultant. The consultant evaluates the patient and determines whether admission is required.

sections.heading: Admission & Eligibility Verification
body: If admission is advised, the patient proceeds to the relevant admission desk for further processing. For patients registered under the Sehat Sahulat Program (SSP), eligibility verification and required approvals are completed through the SSP system. Necessary admission documentation is completed, and the patient file is prepared.

sections.heading: Pre-Procedure Assessment
body: Patients requiring surgery or procedures undergo assessment by the Anesthesia Department. The anesthesia consultant evaluates the patient's fitness for the planned procedure.

sections.heading: Financial Assistance & Category Assessment
body: Patient category and financial arrangements are confirmed according to hospital policy. Eligible patients may receive assistance through applicable support programs, including welfare and financial assistance services.

sections.heading: Admission, Treatment & Discharge
body: After completion of admission formalities, the patient is shifted to the relevant ward. Treatment, surgery, or medical management is provided according to the consultant's advice. During the hospital stay, patient care, medicines, investigations, and treatment records are managed through the inpatient care system.
After completion of treatment, the final bill and discharge documentation are prepared. The patient receives a discharge summary and necessary instructions before leaving the hospital.

title: Patient Rights & Responsibilities
description: Your rights, dignity, and responsibilities as a patient at Hijaz Hospital.
excerpt: Hijaz Hospital is committed to protecting the rights, dignity, and well-being of every patient while fostering cooperation between patients, attendants, and healthcare teams.

hero.title: Patient Rights & Responsibilities
hero.excerpt: Hijaz Hospital is committed to protecting the rights, dignity, and well-being of every patient. Quality healthcare is achieved through mutual respect, cooperation, and partnership between patients, attendants, and healthcare teams.

sections.heading: Your Rights as a Patient
items: Right to Respect & Dignity — treated with respect, compassion, and dignity regardless of religion, gender, age, or financial status
Right to Quality Healthcare — safe, appropriate, and professional medical care according to established hospital standards
Right to Privacy & Confidentiality — personal information, medical records, and treatment details are kept confidential
Right to Information — clear information regarding diagnosis, treatment plan, medicines, and possible risks and benefits
Right to Informed Consent — information and consent before major procedures or surgeries, except in emergencies
Right to Emergency Care — emergency medical care without unnecessary delay
Right to Respectful Communication — ask questions and receive understandable explanations
Right to Second Opinion — seek a second medical opinion from another qualified healthcare professional
Right to Complaint & Feedback — share concerns or suggestions without fear of discrimination
Right to Financial Transparency — clear information regarding treatment costs and available welfare assistance

sections.heading: Your Responsibilities as a Patient
items: Provide accurate and complete medical history, medications, allergies, and personal details
Follow treatment plans, medication instructions, and guidance from healthcare professionals
Treat doctors, nurses, and hospital staff with respect and cooperation
Follow hospital policies including visiting hours, cleanliness standards, and safety protocols
Use hospital facilities, equipment, and resources responsibly
Complete necessary financial requirements or contact the welfare department if assistance is required
Follow hygiene instructions and infection control guidelines
Maintain a respectful environment — violence, aggressive behavior, and smoking are not permitted
Attend scheduled follow-up appointments and investigations as advised
Cooperate with healthcare teams to ensure safe and effective treatment outcomes
